StudentHub — Customer Handover Package
======================================
For: Windows 10 / Windows 11

WHAT TO COPY
------------
Copy this entire folder to the school PC:

  StudentHub.exe
  data\
    students.db
    admin_credentials.json

Keep the data folder in the same place as StudentHub.exe always.


HOW TO START
------------
1. Double-click StudentHub.exe
2. Login:
     Username: admin
     Password: admin125
3. Change password after first login (Forgot Password on login screen)


MAIN FEATURES
-------------
- Add Student
- View Students (filter, edit, promote)
- Certificates (LC and Bonafide) with student search and scroll list
- Backup (save database copy)


IMPORTANT — DATA SAFETY
-----------------------
All student records are saved in:

  data\students.db

DO NOT delete the data folder.
Take backup regularly from Backup menu in the app.


IF APP DOES NOT OPEN
--------------------
Install Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64):
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist

Screen resolution: 1024 x 768 or higher recommended.


SUPPORT NOTE
------------
If you move the app to another PC, copy both StudentHub.exe and the data folder together.

Built: 2026-06-06
Platform: Windows 10 / 11
